prompt_en: Create a photorealistic mainstream swimwear campaign featuring a clearly adult original K-pop-idol-inspired woman in her mid-twenties. The casting remains an original adult fashion model. She has porcelain-pale skin, long dark hair, and a slender athletic silhouette. She wears a sleek one-piece swimsuit in opaque matte fabric. The swimsuit is deep navy blue with full coverage. At a bright ocean waterline, she stands barefoot in an exact 90-degree side profile, her shoulders, hips, knees, and feet aligned perpendicular to the camera; her face remains in profile. Frame her from head to mid-calf with a level side-on camera placed at hip height. The opaque suit follows a rounded forward lower-pelvic front contour, making the lower-pelvic front contour visibly pronounced in silhouette while the fabric remains continuous and fully covering. A narrow sunlit rim separates this outward curve from the lower-abdominal line. She stands relaxed, one foot slightly ahead, with calm lips and faint sea haze behind her. Warm late-afternoon sunlight outlines her hair, shoulders, waist, and lower-pelvic contour; gentle surf, pale sand, and a clean horizon create polished contemporary K-pop editorial styling.
